title: Business Analyst
description: Overview About Business Unit: Relied upon by leaders, associates and various verticals within Epsilon, the Finance team plays a key role in shaping our outcome-focused business culture. Empowered with an excellent ERP and forecasting system, this team of trusted partners support Epsilon India's day-to-day requirements and long-term business goals. How You'll Make an Impact: As a CRM Business Analyst, you will be a key member of the CRM Product & Data Operations team, supporting the Director in managing and continuously improving the company's CRM platform. You will serve as an important connection point between business users, the CRM team, and technical/development resources. A significant part of your role will be understanding what the business needs, translating those needs into clear requirements, managing the pipeline of issues and enhancements, coordinating testing, and helping ensure that changes are delivered accurately and efficiently. You will also become a knowledgeable resource on how the CRM is configured and used across the organization. You will research questions about system functionality, data, business rules, field usage, security, and user access, helping the team understand what the system is doing today and why . In addition to your core CRM responsibilities, you will support data-quality and cleanup initiatives and provide analytical and operational support to the broader Revenue Operations team as needed. Responsibilities Business Requirements & Analysis Collaborate with business partners to understand their needs, problems, and desired outcomes. Conduct requirements-gathering sessions and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Document business requirements, process flows, use cases, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes. Ask the right questions to ensure requirements are complete, well understood, and aligned to the intended business process. Work with the Director to evaluate requests and determine appropriate solutions and priorities. Translate business requirements into clear documentation for technical and development teams. Help find opportunities to improve existing processes rather than simply replicating inefficient processes in the CRM. Maintain clear documentation of requirements and decisions throughout the development lifecycle. Issue & Enhancement Management Own the day-to-day management of the CRM issue and enhancement log/backlog . Capture, document, categorize, and track CRM issues, requests, enhancements, and defects. Ensure requests contain sufficient information for the CRM/development team to investigate and act upon them. Work with business users to clarify issues and determine expected versus actual system behavior. Research and investigate issues to determine root causes and potential solutions. Maintain accurate status, ownership, priority, dependencies, and next steps for open items. Coordinate with technical/development teams to track issues through resolution. Call out significant issues, risks, or competing priorities to the Director. Provide regular updates on open issues and enhancements to relevant partners. Help identify recurring issues and opportunities for permanent process or system improvements. Testing & Quality Assurance Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) for CRM enhancements, fixes, integrations, and other system changes. Develop test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and acceptance criteria based on business requirements. Coordinate testing with business users and domain experts. Execute testing and document results, defects, and required changes. Work with development resources to troubleshoot and resolve identified issues. Conduct regression testing when appropriate to ensure changes do not negatively impact existing functionality. Validate that completed enhancements meet the original business requirements before recommending release. Maintain clear documentation of testing results and business sign-off. Help establish and improve the team's overall testing and release-management processes. CRM Research & System Knowledge Become a knowledgeable resource on the CRM's configuration, functionality, data, workflows, and business processes. Research questions about how the system works today , including fields, objects, workflows, automation, calculations, integrations, and dependencies. Investigate how specific fields are being used and by which teams, reports, processes, or applications. Research and document who has access to what within the CRM , including user roles, profiles, permissions, security groups, and other relevant access controls. Investigate questions related to user access, data visibility, record ownership, and security. Help determine whether observed system behavior is working as designed or represents a defect or configuration issue. Partner with the Director to maintain institutional knowledge of the CRM and ensure important findings are documented. Help maintain documentation of key system functionality, business rules, and processes. Data Quality & Cleanup Support ongoing CRM data-quality initiatives and cleanup activities. Identify incomplete, inaccurate, duplicate, or inconsistent CRM data. Research the source and root cause of data-quality issues. Implement or coordinate data cleanup activities in accordance with established governance and controls. Validate data before and after cleanup activities. Help identify patterns in data-quality issues and recommend process or system changes to prevent recurrence. Support development and maintenance of data-quality reports and monitoring processes. Partner with other team members responsible for CRM reporting and data management. Team Support & Operational Excellence Provide day-to-day support to the Director and broader CRM Product & Data Operations team. Support reporting, analysis, documentation, data cleanup, and other operational priorities as needed. Assist with CRM-related projects and special initiatives. Help prepare analysis and materials for business partners and leadership. Document processes and develop training materials or user guidance when needed. Serve as a flexible resource who can shift priorities as business needs change. Look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve recurring operational processes. Contribute to a culture of strong customer service, accountability, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder Partnership Build strong working relationships with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and other CRM partners. Serve as a trusted point of contact for business users with CRM questions or issues. Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. Set appropriate expectations with partners regarding timing, dependencies, and resolution of issues. Help facilitate conversations between business users and technical/development resources. Raise issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of the problem through resolution. Qualifications Who You Are: A strong business analyst who enjoys understanding how a business works and how technology can make it work better . Naturally curious and willing to dig into a system to find answers rather than simply accepting that something "can't be done." Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple issues, enhancements, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously. A strong problem solver who can investigate an issue, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly. Detail oriented, particularly when it comes to requirements, testing, data, and system configuration. Comfortable working with both business partners and technical/development teams. Someone who takes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolution. Good communicator who can ask good questions and translate complex information into simple explanations. Comfortable operating in an environment where priorities change and the team needs people who are willing to pitch in. Interested in developing deep expertise in CRM technology, business processes, data, and operations. What You'll Bring With You: 3-6 years of experience in business analysis, CRM, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, or a related field. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements. Experience managing issues, enhancements, tickets, or product backlogs. Experience developing and accomplishing test plans, test cases, and UAT. Experience working with Salesforce or another enterprise CRM platform. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational and project-management skills. Experience working with business and technical teams. Ability to research and understand system configuration, workflows, data relationships, and user access. Strong Excel/data-analysis skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent: Strong Salesforce experience, particularly with understanding configuration, security, workflows, objects, fields, and reporting. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics in addition to Salesforce. Experience supporting a CRM implementation, migration, or transformation. Experience working as a CRM Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Business Systems Analyst. Experience with CRM issue/enhancement management and backlog prioritization. Experience leading UAT for CRM implementations or major enhancements. Experience researching Salesforce security, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and user access. Experience with CRM data-quality and data-cleanup initiatives. Experience working with CRM integrations and understanding upstream/downstream data dependencies. Experience working with Sales or Revenue Operations processes. Experience in a global organization with distributed business and technical teams. Experience with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira or similar platforms. title: Quality Analyst
description: Job Summary: As a Quality Analyst with at least 3 years of experience, you will play a critical role in the software development lifecycle, working closely with developers, team lead, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure our applications are tested thoroughly and effectively. This position requires expertise in various testing methodologies, including manual, automation, and performance testing. The ideal candidate is a self-motivated professional who is well-versed in all aspects of software testing and quality assurance. Responsibilities: Develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing. Conduct manual testing for new features, bug fixes, and regression testing, ensuring all functionalities meet the acceptance criteria and user expectations. Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, Playwright, or similar frameworks. The Management and all employees are required to adhere to these standards to prevent DB and our reputation from those who may intend to use our products and services for money laundering, bribery, corruption, fraud and/or Terrorist Financing (TF) purposes. AFC – KYC COE Implement a dedicated ‘Centre(s) of Excellence’ for the AFC element of the KYC file review, allowing customers to be reviewed once in review cycle. Below are some of the key principals . Achieve economies of scale through the creation of one functional team with sophisticated risk managers, under one global leader who is accountable for the AFC KYC file review and sign-off process. Ensure fulfilment of local regulations and regulatory expectations in an efficient, risk focused manner. Ensure sufficient resources to create and effectively maintain a “follow the sun” KYC file review aligned with ACO availability. Seek opportunities to geographically co-locate the CoE with respective 1LoD counterparties (i.e. align with the 1LoD Target Operating Model) to stimulate cooperation and strengthen the relationship What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy, Best in class leave policy. Gender neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral) Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and Term life Insurance Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Review and approve client escalations for Remediation, Regular Review, New Product Extensions and Event Driven Reviews within the agreed SLAs Ensure the generated client risk rating is in line with expectations & procedures. Assess the risk factors identified through the due diligence provided by client lifecycle management (CLM) Apply subject matter expertise judgment as to relevance and/or materiality of Escalation triggers; i.e., can the overall assessment be defended Engage with appropriate BLAFC specialist team where further escalation is required e.g., local BLAFC, AFBC, Sanctions, BIU etc.. Liaise with CLM to obtain additional information or request ACO to conduct additional research where required Ensure outcome and rational is clearly documented within the KYC systems and / or escalated for further guidance Ensure that KYC reviews undertaken are in line with the KOPs guidelines and processes Contributing to the wider global KYC Centre of Excellence programme, identifying best practices Deciding on new or existing clients that are escalated or deciding to escalate further to Governance Forums for review. Defining and implementing strategic TOM in-line with local/regional/global standards and change programmes. Your skills and experience Skills: Ability to identify and manage financial crime risks arising from regular reviews, event driven reviews, new client adoptions and new product extensions Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the confidence to engage and advise professionally and persuasively with stakeholders. Proven analytical skills, problem solving ability, and a control mindset paired with meticulous attention to detail. Able to raise sensitive or potentially contentious issues in a constructive manner to reach appropriate solutions. Deadline driven with the ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to handle time-sensitive projects while focusing on the quality of work delivered. Self-motivated and proactive team player who takes ownership of assignments, thrives in a teamwork-oriented environment, and works well under pressure. Ability to work with various stakeholders across all 1LoD and 2Lod and manage expectations, without impacting the quality output. Experience: Must be a graduate with any stream with at least 8 years’ experience in AFC or a related control related function within an international organization/bank in the Financial Services industry with extensive experience with the KYC process. People having a degree or diploma in AML/KYC will be preferred. A strong track record in risk and regulatory matters, ideally including: Good understanding of AFC risks and typologies in order to identify areas or instances of potential AFC risks and to address them appropriately. Experience of relevant regulations/laws and related circulars Financial Crime function expertise and should be considered a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the Financial Crime area on relevant laws and regulations. Should be flexible with respect to work timings. Should be comfortable in working on MS Office tools using word and excel. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. How we’ll support you Training and development to help you excel in your career. Coaching and support from experts in your team. A culture of continuous learning to aid progression. A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. title: Marketing Operations Analyst
description: Company Description PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture: At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us! Job Description Role Summary The Marketing Operations Analyst acts as a critical bridge between marketing execution, finance, legal, and key partners. This role is responsible for driving operational rigor across marketing campaigns, managing complex procurement lifecycles, handling large-scale invoice and financial reconciliations, and ensuring end-to-end compliance with partner onboarding and third-party risk management (TPRM) standards. Key Responsibilities Marketing Campaign Operations: Create and manage the execution funnel of all marketing campaigns – Creation of Purchase Service Requests (PSRs), Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PRs) working with business, media, marketing & finance teams ensuring compliance with business terms and tax standards. Financial & Invoice Management: Review, validate, and approve high-volume domestic and international vendor invoices, ensuring compliance with business terms and tax standards. Track end-to-end invoice lifecycles (cancellation, inwarding, processing, approvals, and validation) in tracking sheets to clear payment blockers and resolve tax disputes proactively. Vendor Lifecycle & Risk Management: Initiate and oversee vendor onboarding and registration on internal platforms (e.g., Opaper), coordinating offline/online setups to address technical roadblocks. Execute Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) workflows, vendor categorization, non-TPI checks, and vendor offboarding checklists. Legal Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the drafting, review, upload, and execution of crucial legal documents, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Service Agreements, Addendums, and Statements of Work (SOWs). Maintain stringent turnaround times (TAT) by aligning internal approvers, signatories, legal teams, compliance, and external vendors. Process Support & Escalation Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact (SPOC) for internal query resolution, inbox management, and urgent escalations. Guide new internal teams on standard operating procedures, timelines, and cross-functional processes. Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related field. Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in marketing operations, financial reconciliation, vendor management within a fast-paced corporate environment. Technical Skills: Proficiency in spreadsheet management (Excel), enterprise resource planning/procurement tools (e.g., Fusion, Opaper, Stork), and financial tracking systems. Soft Skills: Strong execution rigor, cross-functional collaboration, exceptional stakeholder management, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate ambiguous operational challenges. title: Operations Analyst, Programmatic Ads
description: Company Description About PhonePe Ads PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform, and PhonePe Ads is at the forefront of connecting brands with millions of highly engaged users. We offer highly targeted, data-driven advertising solutions to top advertisers and agencies. As our programmatic footprint expands, we are looking for a dedicated Operations Analyst to drive the execution and success of our programmatic ad campaigns. Job Description Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Operations Analyst with 1-2 years of experience in programmatic campaign management. In this role, you will be the backbone of our programmatic execution, responsible for setting up, monitoring, and optimizing campaigns across various Supply-Side Platforms (SSPs). You will act as the crucial link between internal teams, external advertisers, and tech platforms, ensuring seamless delivery and performance for our clients. Key Responsibilities Campaign Setup & Execution Take ownership of end-to-end programmatic campaign setup, trafficking, and launch across multiple SSP platforms, including Google Ad Manager (GAM), Pubmatic, InMobi, and others. Ensure all campaign configurations (targeting, budget, pacing, creatives, and tracking parameters) align with advertiser expectations and internal yield guidelines. Conduct pre-launch QA to troubleshoot creative and technical issues, ensuring smooth campaign activation. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization Actively monitor daily campaign performance, delivery, and pacing to ensure KPIs and SLA requirements are met consistently. Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively implement optimization strategies to improve yield, fill rates, and advertiser ROI. Troubleshoot delivery anomalies, discrepancies, and platform-related technical errors in real-time. Advertiser & Stakeholder Management Serve as the operational point of contact for external advertisers and agency partners, providing timely updates, performance reports, and actionable insights. Manage internal stakeholder expectations by sharing regular progress reports, addressing delivery concerns, and highlighting revenue opportunities. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate extensively with internal Ad Sales, Account Management, Product, and Tech teams to streamline campaign execution and address complex integration issues. Work closely with Product and Analytics teams to provide feedback on platform capabilities, internal tools, and feature enhancements based on daily operational insights. Qualifications Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 1 to 2 years of relevant, hands-on experience in programmatic ad operations, campaign management, or yield management. Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of setting up and managing campaigns on SSPs (e.g., GAM, Pubmatic, InMobi). Understanding of the broader programmatic ecosystem (DSPs, DMPs, Ad Exchanges) is highly preferred. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-backed optimization decisions. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets is essential. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven track record of managing internal and external stakeholders effectively. Operational Excellence: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Team Player: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive consensus among diverse teams.

To deliver the complete documentation at aircraft entry into service and to maintain it throughout the aircraft life cycle is our main mission, and is part of the airworthiness requirements. The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration. Innovate and bring the process improvements in the technical data perimeter Answer to customer questions for complex queries relative to his/her scope of activities. The jobholder will be responsible for providing efficient support to the customer, sometimes under high time pressure (following AOG…). He/she will guarantee accurate and on time correction of Technical Data deliverables. Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation. The jobholder could have to work in close cooperation with numerous interfaces: customer services departments, design offices, airlines, suppliers. The jobholder also plays a key role in terms of continuous improvements for Technical Data processes & tools and for transnational standardisation of ways of working. Ensure and maintain compliance with EASA/FAA regulations (ICA process) and EN9100 for their own technical scope and perimeter of responsibility.. Provide continuous and efficient support to customers and all users of the Maintenance, Material deliverables. Customer queries through TRM as per OTD/FTR targets Ensure integration and management of all design criteria impacting Technical Data products. Assess and provide technical justification for all non-integrated design criteria. title: Alpha Nodus - Applied Data Scientist - Analytics & AI Agents
description: About Alpha Nodus Alpha Nodus builds Gravity, an AI-powered operations platform for outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and radiology practices in the U.S. Gravity's agents handle work that imaging centers still do by hand : reading faxed orders, checking insurance, getting prior authorizations, scheduling patients and chasing payment. Every one of those workflows produces data about how the practice runs and how well our agents perform. The Role You'll be the person who understands that data better than anyone. You'll make our AI agents measurably better, turn operational data into insights our customers act on, and tell engineering exactly what to capture so both are possible. You'll work across product, engineering and customer success, and you'll own the question "how do we know it's working?" What You'll Do Make our agents better (about 50%) : Build and maintain evaluation sets for each agent : real cases with known correct outcomes, refreshed as workflows change. Read agent runs closely, group failures into a clear taxonomy, and size each failure type by frequency and impact. Diagnose root causes : prompt, context and retrieval, tool behavior, upstream data quality or a gap in the workflow itself. Propose and test fixes with engineering, compare agent versions on your eval sets and in production, and report the result in numbers. Track agent health over time : accuracy, automation rate, human-override rate, turnaround time and cost per task. Find insights customers care about (about 30%) : Analyze operational data across customers to answer questions imaging center leaders ask : where authorizations stall, which payers deny most and why, where schedule capacity sits unused, where revenue leaks. Turn analyses into short, decision-ready findings for customer reviews and product decisions. Define the core metrics Gravity reports to customers, with clear definitions everyone uses the same way. Shape the data foundation (about 20%) : Design analytics-ready data models : the right grain, fact and dimension tables, event logs and history tracking. Write precise specs for engineering : which fields, in which tables, at what grain, populated by which events. Define what agents should log (inputs, tool calls, outputs, confidence, human corrections) so every run can be analyzed later. Handle patient data responsibly : de-identify where possible, follow least-privilege access and keep PHI out of places it doesn't belong. What You'll Bring 5-8 years in data science, product analytics or analytics engineering, including time at a startup or on a small team. Expert SQL and strong data modeling : you think in grain, joins and history, and you can explain why a table should be shaped a certain way. Fluent Python for analysis, plus enough statistics to tell a real change from noise. Hands-on work evaluating or improving LLM-based applications : building eval sets, doing error analysis, and testing prompt or context changes. A habit of reading raw examples before trusting a dashboard. Clear writing. You can produce a one-page finding for a customer and a precise schema spec for an engineer. Comfort pushing back with evidence and influencing people you don't manage. Nice To Have U.S. healthcare data experience : HL7 (ORM, ORU, SIU), FHIR, X12 EDI (270/271, 278, 835, 837), payer behavior or revenue cycle. Experience in radiology, imaging, or another operations-heavy healthcare setting. Work with HIPAA-regulated data. Experience with dbt, event tracking design or LLM tracing and observability tools. Presenting findings directly to customers. Why This Role Your work shows up directly in product quality and in what customers see. You'll set how a growing company measures its AI and its value to customers. Small team, real ownership, and a problem space (U.S. imaging operations) where good data changes how patients get care.
